en: Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with a pond or small lake in the center. In the foreground several people in early 20th‑century clothing sit on white benches along a path facing the water. Across the pond is a tree‑lined shore with umbrellas or kiosks and a small pavilion or café building with a red roof on the right. Dense trees surround the water, and faintly in the distant background there appear to be spires or towers rising above the treetops. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
